profile.ageHelp: Your date of birth is used for the age adjustment for bronze, silver and gold series. Precision thresholds decrease by 1 point from age 55 and 2 points from age 65, using age at the end of the previous calendar year. Application requirements are unchanged. Rules are selected by the session date. Previously recorded birth information is used when available; older series without it use the profile. Without birth information, standard thresholds apply.
profile.birthYearHelp: . It is used until you enter a date of birth.
profile.closeHelp: To also close your account, contact the installation owner. They remove your GitHub ID from the server allowlist. Complete erasure also requires handling Git history, clones and backups.
profile.deleteHelp: This removes your sessions, firearms, profile and assessments from the current journal. Previous versions remain in Git history. Export first if you want a copy.
profile.exportFailed: The export could not be downloaded.
profile.exportHelp: JSON includes firearms, your profile, raw results and assessments. CSV contains results for spreadsheets.
profile.heading: Your profile
profile.importHelp: Existing IDs are skipped. Import is atomic and affects only your account. Your existing profile is kept. Imported assessments are personal records, not verified certificates.
profile.invalidJson: The file is not valid JSON.
qualifications.help: Personal progress based on your saved results and the series rule version.
qualifications.intro: Achievements and remaining tests, with traceable rules.
qualifications.path: Standard pistol shooting badge test route
qualifications.sourceHelp: The edition is published by SPSF and obtained through Svenska PPC-cupen. Later amendments have not been fully reviewed. Current metadata and limitations are documented in docs/RULES.md. Assessments are shown for each session. Rules are selected by the session date; previously recorded birth information is used when available, otherwise the profile is used.

rules.applicationInput: Application assessment requires six shots, a hit count and shooting time.
rules.beforeBirth: The test date is before the date or year of birth.
rules.noVersion: No verified rule version covers the result date.

rules.precisionInput: Precision assessment requires five shots and a whole-number score from 0 to 50.
rules.precisionScoreNoBirth: {points} out of at least {threshold} points. No age adjustment; birth information is missing.
rules.progressHelp: Three recorded precision achievements plus three application achievements within the calendar year. Each series uses its recorded rules and birth information. Alternative test routes, previous badges and club decisions are assessed separately. Not an official certificate.
rules.unsupportedGroup: This weapon group is not covered by the implemented test route.
rules.unsupportedSport: Badge and medal rules for this discipline are not implemented yet.
session.deleteHelp: Remove this session and its assessments from the current journal? Git history is kept.
session.legacyHelp: This older session has different distances, targets or times per series. They are kept until you select a shared value above.
session.linkQuickHelp: quick series will be linked when you save the session. Their date and discipline are kept.
session.newHelp: Save your results while the experience is fresh.
session.resultsHelp: Enter raw results before deductions. Enter deductions separately. Competition ranking and rule-based penalties are not calculated automatically.
session.revisionHelp: A new revision and assessments are saved. Previous assessments are kept.
session.sharedHelp: Distance, target type and shooting time apply to every series in the session.
sessions.emptyHelp: Record your first session and follow your progress over time.
